question: In the experimental matrix of sewage sludge co-incineration in a fluidized bed, which runs vary the bed particle size, and to what sizes?
expect: runs 6 and 7: 545 um and 775 um (all other runs 650 um) (Table 2)
rendered:
The experimental matrix in Table 2 on page 2 shows that runs 6, 7, and 13 vary the bed particle size. 

Run 6 has a bed particle size of 545 μm.
Run 7 has a bed particle size of 775 μm.
Run 13 has a bed particle size of 650 μm.
